svg.title: Matched SQLite plugin and existing engine crossover
svg.desc: Shared fixture transitions plus materialization and count, milliseconds on a logarithmic axis. Marks show median and whiskers minimum to maximum across successful exact-state matched repetitions. PostgreSQL and SQLite commit durable writes; DD is volatile.
svg.text: Matched circuit states: write through result materialization
PG/SQLite durable; DD volatile. Exact validation outside timing. Median [min, max] ms.
Total memory cap unenforced. Native SQL includes client/server command latency; DD uses keyed in-process writes.
